DMS raised its FY forecast with H1 in each of the last two years and the FY27 plan was set flat on an actual it beat by 11.3% while Q1 OP rose 26.6%; with no consensus anywhere and nothing pre-released, a raise is unpriced by construction, discounted for the naphtha headwind management says is excluded from the plan.
